name: io.github.larpey/intomd
title: intomd
description: Convert files, URLs and text to LLM-ready Markdown with paging, provenance and warnings.

environmentVariables.name: INTOMD_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Default output profile: full, compact, rag or agent

environmentVariables.name: INTOMD_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Directories convert_file may read, separated by the OS path separator (default: working directory)

environmentVariables.name: INTOMD_REMOTE
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of an intomd instance; converts there instead of in-process

environmentVariables.name: INTOMD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for INTOMD_REMOTE, sent as X-API-Key

host.description: Host name of the intomd instance (public or self-hosted)

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token: an API key for the instance
